design.list.title: Design
design.list.subtitle: Multi-artboard design canvases, edited by hand or by AI.
design.list.importHint: Paste the full HTML of a published design canvas page. Its artboards, layout and images are read from the embedded state block.
design.detail.restoreNote: Restoring copies an old version forward as a new one; nothing is lost.
design.ai.heading: Edit with AI
design.ai.hint: Describe the change. The canvas is validated before it is stored, and the previous version is kept if the result is invalid.
design.ai.placeholder: Make the hero headline larger and move the call to action above the fold…
design.ai.gateNote: Works with any configured provider — the same prompt and the same validation either way.
design.source.heading: Source
design.props.heading: Properties
design.props.nothingSelected: Click an element on the artboard to edit it.
design.props.clickHint: Clicking selects instead of interacting while this panel is open.
design.props.textBound: This text comes from the artboard logic and cannot be edited here.
design.props.customTracksHint: These grid tracks are not all equal, so they are edited in the source.
design.tweaks.heading: Tweaks
design.props.interactiveHint: This artboard is marked interactive, so its own controls keep working and elements are not selectable. Edit it in the Source panel.
design.export.unavailable: Printing needs a headless browser, and none is available.
design.export.paperHint: Only used by artboards set to flow. Fixed artboards print at their own size.
design.canvas.navHint: Drag the background to move · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom · open an artboard from its title
design.ai.slowHint: A large canvas on a CLI provider can take several minutes. You can leave this page — the outcome is recorded either way.
